719-5231-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-5231-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-3698-4030-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3698-4030-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Starnheim Courser.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.

1580-2511-4871-6248.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6556-7742.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6556-7742.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

3525-6723-7734.description:
Activate Wakandan Tusker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Wakandan Tusker triggers, causing you to scry 1 and gain 1 life
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Wakandan Tusker.
Repeat.

856-4050-5776-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2546-6089-6786.easyPrerequisites: You have a land card in hand or on top of your library.
2546-6089-6786.description:
Cast Library of Leng by paying {1}.
When Library of Leng enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers, causing you to draw a card and then discard a land card.
The discarded card is put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Library of Leng.
Surly Badgersaur triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Skyswimmer Koi triggers, causing you to draw a card and then discard a land card.
Repeat from step 3.

2440-7082-7109-7297.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-6441-6633.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

3713-4316-5078-6723.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

5170-5686-6132-6273.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

147-5256-6814.description:
Cast Abnormal Endurance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Abnormal Endurance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Abnormal Endurance.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities from step 5.

874-985-4195-4574.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-985-4195-4574.description:
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Delif's Cone from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Delif's Cone from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2981-3490-4871-6829.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
2981-3490-4871-6829.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Venom and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Venom trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

2060-3705-3967-6701.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying its mana cost.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Squee.
When Squee is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
2060-3705-3967-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4050-4550-5567-6254--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4050-4550-5567-6254--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

2534-3817-3967-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Coercive Recruiter, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

1308-2457-5794-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2523-4050-5563.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Uruk-hai Berserker, adding one mana of any color.
When Uruk-hai Berserker dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Uruk-hai Berserker that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Uruk-hai Berserker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Uruk-hai Berserker token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Repeat.

804-5330-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Sakashima the Impostor on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
804-5330-5365.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Sakashima the Impostor's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sakashima the Impostor.
Sakashima the Impostor's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.
804-5330-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

1308-4871-6074.description:
During your upkeep, activate Nim Devourer by paying {B}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then sacrificing it.
When Nim Devourer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

1887-2292-3305-4022-5926.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating a token copy of each creature card in your graveyard that is a 1/1 Insect.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, the Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and the Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the Hidden Herbalist trigger, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

1682-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six mana-producing lands, two of which can produce at least {U}.
1682-3542.description:
Activate six lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers six times, adding {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1799-2048-3621-5147.notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of eight or greater.
1799-2048-3621-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

803-4218.description: Activate The World Tree's second ability by paying {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to search for all creatures in your library, as they are all Gods due to Arcane Adaptation and put them onto the battlefield.

1939-2034-3263-3860.description:
Cast Lunarch Veteran from your graveyard for its disturb cost by paying {2}, causing it to enter the battlefield transformed as Luminous Phantom.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Luminous Phantom, adding {2}.
Because Overwhelming Splendor causes Luminous Phantom to lose all abilities, it is not exiled when it is sacrificed, and is returned to your graveyard as Lunarch Veteran.
Repeat.

2281-4681-5147.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Karmic Guide
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide dies, Saffi triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2837-3868-4231.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2837-3868-4231.description:
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three creatures you control, creating either three 2/2 Cat or 3/1 Dog creature tokens.
Repeat.

1267-3632-4464-4600-5241.notablePrerequisites: Slither Blade does not have summoning sickness.
1267-3632-4464-4600-5241.description:
Declare Slither Blade as an attacker.
During the declare blockers phase, when you recieve priority, activate Sakashima's Student's Ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Slither Blade from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sakashima's Student from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai.
Deal combat damage with Sakashima's Student, causing you to take an additional turn after this one.
Cast Slither Blade by paying {U}.
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Sakashima's Student from the battlefield to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

2104-3429-3554.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Invent by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Invent and Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
